$comment: Prompts for this game's art: npm run gen:asset -- tien-len/<name> (the style in assets/prompts.json is added). blossom, emblem: Made with Antigravity (agy, its built-in image tool), which saves into ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/brain/; transparent ones were asked for on flat #00FF00 and keyed with games/checkers/sources/key_green.py.

island.prompt: A floating sky island: rocky brown underside tapering to a point with a few hanging vines, lush green grass on top, and on top a round wooden table covered in green felt with a fanned-out hand of oversized playing cards showing only big red heart and black spade suit symbols (no numbers or letters) and a small face-down stack of cards, a red paper lantern on a pole. Isometric 3/4 view, whole island visible.

face-classic.prompt: One blank playing card face seen exactly from the front, flat orthographic view, tall portrait rectangle with a 5:7 aspect ratio and softly rounded corners, warm ivory card stock with a very subtle paper texture and a thin darker cream inner border line. Completely empty face: no suit symbols, no pips, no pictures.

back-lotus.prompt: The back of one playing card seen exactly from the front, flat orthographic view, tall portrait rectangle with a 5:7 aspect ratio and softly rounded corners, white outer border, inside a rich red field with a symmetric golden lotus and cloud ornament pattern in Vietnamese Tet style.

back-lattice.prompt: The back of one playing card seen exactly from the front, flat orthographic view, filling the frame: a tall portrait rectangle with a 2:3 aspect ratio and softly rounded corners. A wide clean white border all around, inside it a dark teal-green printed field covered edge to edge in a fine symmetric lattice of tiny diamonds, crosshatch lines and small rosettes in thin white lines, like the classic cheap casino poker decks sold everywhere in Vietnam. A thin white double frame line just inside the field and one small ornate white medallion in the exact center. Crisp flat printed ink on card stock, perfectly symmetric top to bottom and left to right, no text, no letters, no logo.

suit-spade.prompt: A single glossy black spade card-suit symbol, chunky and slightly puffy like a candy, seen straight from the front.

suit-club.prompt: A single glossy black club (clover) card-suit symbol, chunky and slightly puffy like a candy, seen straight from the front.

suit-diamond.prompt: A single glossy red diamond card-suit symbol, chunky and slightly puffy like a candy, seen straight from the front.

suit-heart.prompt: A single glossy red heart card-suit symbol, chunky and slightly puffy like a candy, seen straight from the front.

button.prompt: A blank wide rounded-rectangle game button, glossy golden-yellow like the buttons of a cheerful mobile game, thick darker orange bottom edge for depth, seen straight from the front, empty face.

blossom.prompt: A single decorative branch of Vietnamese Tet peach blossom (hoa dao) for the corner of a mobile game screen: a dark brown gnarled twig running diagonally from the top right corner toward the lower left, with about twelve soft pink five-petal blossoms, a few buds and small fresh green leaves, and one small red paper lucky charm with a gold tassel hanging from it. Polished stylized 3D cartoon art, soft rounded chunky shapes, light from the top left, each outline a darker shade of its own fill. The branch only, nothing else. Background: perfectly flat solid pure green #00FF00 everywhere, no shadow on the background, no gradient. No text, letters, frame or watermark.

emblem.prompt: A single game emblem icon, polished stylized 3D cartoon art for a cheerful Vietnamese casual mobile card game: a small fanned hand of five chunky cream playing cards with rounded corners, the front card a red two of hearts, tucked against a small red Tet lucky-money envelope (li xi) with a gold flower print, and one sprig of pink peach blossom lying across them. Front view, slightly from above, centered, compact, filling about 80 percent of a square frame, light from the top left, soft rounded chunky shapes, each outline a darker shade of its own fill (never black). Background: perfectly flat solid pure green #00FF00 everywhere, no shadow on the background, no gradient. No text, letters except the card corner, frame or watermark.
